metadata.agent_last_message:
All pending warnings are now implemented:

- **`nonexistent_local_time`** — fires when a local time falls in a spring-forward gap (timezone.cpp:133-140)
- **`timezone_fold_ambiguous`** — fires when a local time is ambiguous due to fall-back overlap (timezone.cpp:146-157)
- **`duplicate_uid`** — detects multiple base components sharing the same UID (parser.cpp:1119-1136)
- **`line_too_long`** — flags content lines exceeding 75 octets before unfolding (parser.cpp:1139-1153)

Also fixed: `make_comparable` in expand.cpp now discards warnings to prevent duplicate DST warnings, and the parse error for non-iCal input now says "Missing BEGIN:VCALENDAR" instead of "Empty input".
